nodes.name: telegram

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a file’s details and download it into the item

options.name: Get
options.description: Get up-to-date information about a chat

options.name: Send Chat Action
options.description: Show "typing…" or another status in the chat

options.name: Send Document
options.description: Any file (PDF, CSV, ZIP…)

properties.name: chatId
properties.description: Unique identifier of the chat, or the username of a channel (@channelusername)

properties.name: fileId
properties.description: The file_id of a document, photo, voice note… (from the Telegram Trigger or a sent message)

properties.name: download
properties.description: Put the file in item.binary (the cloud Bot API serves files up to 20 MB); off: only its details

properties.name: binaryData
properties.description: Upload a file of the input item instead of sending a URL or file_id

properties.name: binaryPropertyName
properties.description: The item file to upload (item.binary.<name>)

properties.name: messageId

properties.name: text
properties.description: Text of the message, 1-4096 characters

properties.name: file

properties.description: An HTTP URL Telegram downloads the file from, or the file_id of a file already on Telegram

nodes.name: telegramTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when the bot receives Telegram updates (polls getUpdates, no public URL needed)
nodes.subtitle: every {{pollInterval}}s

properties.name: pollInterval
properties.description: How often to check for new events while the workflow is active

options.description: All update types Telegram sends by default

options.name: Message
options.description: New incoming message of any kind: text, photo, sticker…

options.name: Channel Post
options.description: New post in a channel the bot is an admin of

options.name: Callback Query
options.description: A user pressed an inline keyboard button

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Polls getUpdates, so the bot must have no webhook (Telegram answers 409 otherwise: call deleteWebhook first). Only one poller per bot. Execute in the editor shows up to 5 recent updates without consuming them.

nodes.name: slack
nodes.description: Send, update and delete Slack messages, upload and download files, list channels, look up users and add reactions
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Send, update or delete a Slack message, get its permalink, upload or download a file, list channels, find a user by email, or add an emoji reaction.

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get many channels in the workspace

options.name: Add
options.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message

options.name: Get by Email
options.description: Find a user by email address

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a file’s details and download it into the item

options.name: Upload
options.description: Upload an item file to a channel or thread

properties.name: channelId
properties.description: Pick a channel, or set a channel ID (C0123ABCD) with an expression

properties.name: channelId
properties.description: The channel to share the file in. Pick one, or set a channel ID (C0123ABCD) with an expression

properties.name: binaryPropertyName
properties.description: The item file to upload (item.binary.<name>)

values.name: fileName
values.description: Default: the item file’s name

values.name: title
values.description: Default: the file name

values.name: initial_comment
values.description: Text posted with the file

values.name: thread_ts
values.description: Share the file as a reply in the thread of this message

properties.name: fileId
properties.description: The file’s ID, e.g. from a message event’s files

properties.name: download
properties.description: Whether to put the file in item.binary; off: only its details

properties.name: binaryPropertyName
properties.description: The item.binary field for the downloaded file

properties.name: text
properties.description: Message text (mrkdwn). With blocks it becomes the notification fallback

properties.name: blocksUi
properties.description: Optional Block Kit blocks: a JSON array, or the {"blocks": [...]} object Block Kit Builder exports

properties.name: ts
properties.description: The ts of the message (returned when it was sent)

values.name: thread_ts
values.description: Post as a reply in the thread of this message

values.name: reply_broadcast
values.description: Show a thread reply in the channel too

properties.name: timestamp
properties.description: The ts of the message to react to

properties.name: name
properties.description: Emoji name without colons

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

properties.name: simplify
properties.description: Whether to return a few flat fields instead of the raw Slack object

nodes.name: discord
nodes.description: Send, list, delete and react to Discord messages with a bot, or post through a channel webhook
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Send a Discord message (bot or webhook), list recent messages in a channel, delete a message, or react with an emoji.

options.name: Bot Token
options.description: Manage messages in any channel the bot can see

options.name: Webhook
options.description: Post to one channel through its webhook URL

options.name: Send
options.description: Send a message through the webhook

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Retrieve the latest messages in a channel

options.name: React with Emoji
options.action: React to a message with an emoji

properties.name: guildId
properties.description: The server whose channels are listed below

properties.name: channelId
properties.description: Pick a channel of the server, or set a channel ID with an expression

properties.name: emoji
properties.description: A Unicode emoji, or name:id for a custom emoji

properties.name: content
properties.description: Up to 2000 characters. Optional when embeds are set

properties.name: embeds
properties.description: Optional embed objects as JSON: one object or an array of up to 10

values.name: replyTo
values.description: Send as a reply to this message in the same channel

values.name: username
values.description: Override the webhook's default name

values.name: avatar_url
values.description: Override the webhook's default avatar

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all messages or only up to a limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

properties.name: simplify
properties.description: Whether to return a few flat fields instead of the raw Discord message

nodes.name: whatsApp
nodes.description: Send WhatsApp text, media (by URL) and template messages through the Cloud API
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Send a WhatsApp message (text, or an image, document, audio or video by URL) or an approved template to a phone number in international format.

options.name: Send
options.description: Send a text message, or media by URL

options.name: Send Template
options.description: Send an approved message template

properties.name: phoneNumberId
properties.description: The business phone number to send from (its phone number ID)

properties.name: recipientPhoneNumber
properties.description: International format with country code

properties.name: previewUrl
properties.description: Whether to render a preview of the first URL in the text

properties.name: mediaLink
properties.description: Public HTTPS URL WhatsApp downloads the media from

properties.name: mediaFilename
properties.description: File name shown to the recipient

properties.name: languageCode
properties.description: The language of the approved template, e.g. en_US or de

properties.name: components
properties.description: Optional template components as a JSON array (header, body and button parameters)

nodes.name: emailSend
nodes.description: Send an email through any SMTP server (text, HTML or both)
nodes.subtitle: {{toEmail}}
nodes.toolDescription: Send an email to one or more comma-separated addresses with a subject and a text and/or HTML body.

properties.name: toEmail
properties.description: Comma-separated recipients, each optionally with a name: Nathan Doe <nate@example.com>

options.name: Text
options.description: Plain text only

options.name: HTML
options.description: HTML only

options.name: Both
options.description: HTML with a plain-text alternative (multipart/alternative)

values.name: ccEmail
values.description: Comma-separated

values.name: bccEmail
values.description: Comma-separated; not visible to other recipients

values.name: replyTo
values.description: Where replies go, if not to From

values.name: allowUnauthorizedCerts
values.description: Accept invalid or self-signed server certificates

properties.name: accessToken
properties.description: The bot token @BotFather gives you with /newbot

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it for a local Bot API server or a test double

properties.name: accessToken
properties.description: Bot User OAuth Token from your Slack app ("OAuth & Permissions")

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it only for a proxy or a test double

properties.name: signingSecret
properties.description: From the app's "Basic Information" page. Needed when Slack calls Landflow: agent channels (Events API) and approval buttons (Interactivity).

properties.name: botToken
properties.description: Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it only for a proxy or a test double

properties.name: webhookUrl
properties.description: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy Webhook URL. The URL contains its own token

properties.name: accessToken
properties.description: A System User access token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management

properties.name: businessAccountId
properties.description: The WhatsApp Business Account ID (WhatsApp Manager → API Setup)

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Graph API base, including the version

properties.name: user
properties.description: Leave empty for servers that need no login

properties.name: port
properties.description: 465 for SSL/TLS, 587 (or 25) for STARTTLS

properties.name: secure
properties.description: Connect with TLS from the start (port 465). Off: a plain connection, upgraded with STARTTLS when the server offers it

properties.name: disableStartTls
properties.description: Stay unencrypted even when the server offers STARTTLS (local test servers only)

properties.name: hostName
properties.description: Name sent with EHLO (default: this machine's host name)
